Name: Kimberly's Witch Kitchen for Content Patcher and NEW kitchen island for AT
Author: glymr
Description:
I converted the kitchen from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1375]Kimberly's Witch Kitchen[/url] to work with Content Patcher and 1.6. I also made a matching kitchen island based on the same assets. You will need Content Patcher for the kitchen and Alternative Textures for the kitchen island.

If you're looking for the bed and crib from the original mod, you can find them [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28954]here[/url]﻿. Iceprincess98 has also made a beautiful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29147]PIF conversion of the bathroom[/url] from the original mod!

The witch kitchen from this mod:

[list]
[*]Works in the main Farmhouse
[*]Works in all Cabins
[*]Works in Ginger Island House
[*]Parts or all of each kitchen can be separately turned on or off in each location.
[*]A matching kitchen island is included via the "Festive Dining Table" with Alternative Textures. Items can be placed on this kitchen island.
[*]The stove on Ginger Island can be re-textured to extend the kitchen with Alternative Textures
[*]An "Extra" file is also available that can change the farmhouse, cabins, or Ginger Island interiors (pillars and stairs) (downloadable under "Optional Files")
[/list]
I have recently gotten permission to convert some other kitchen mods, so please Track me if you want to be notified when I upload them!

For a more detailed description, unfold below:

[spoiler] Using GMCM you can enable or disable every part of the kitchen in both the Farmhouse and in player Cabins. (All Cabins will have the same kitchen layout, but the Cabin layouts are separate from the Farmhouse layout.) This mod is designed so that you can use it with another kitchen mod and turn on or off the parts from this mod you wish to use. This mod will overwrite most other kitchen mods, but any part - the oven, the sink, the refrigerator, etc - can easily be turned off, allowing you to mix and match with other kitchen mods.

You can also use this mod in Ginger Island. It looked a little odd with just the oven, sink, and refrigerator, so I made an alternative texture for the stove that puts in the rest of the kitchen counter.

The kitchen island in the image from the original mod was unavailable, so I made my own version using the assets from the mod. For the matching kitchen island, you'll need a "festive dining table". Make sure you have Alternative Textures installed, then use the paint can (purchasable at Robin's) and choose which version of the kitchen island you wish to use. It will only work when the table is in a horizontal configuration; in the vertical configuration, it will look like the regular festive table. Because it's a table, you can place an item on the kitchen island. There are eight different variations. The kitchen island and kitchen mods are packaged together in one folder, but either can be deleted without affecting the other.

In the "Other Files" section of the Files tab, you will also find an "Extra" that changes some of the farmhouse interior, mainly coloring the pillars and stairs pink or white. This was part of the original mod, and I included it here for fun just in case anyone wanted it. Like the kitchen, it is fully configurable using GMCM.[/spoiler]

SPECIAL THANKS to TricksyFox! The original mod didn't have an "open door" version of the refrigerator, so TricksyFox made one for me, and it looks great! <3

According to the original mod, portions of the assets were based on [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/432/?]Witchy-Gothic Interior UPDATED FOR 1.1[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/854/?tab=3&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmodimages%2F%3Fuser%3D0%26id%3D854%26gid%3D1303]Classy new interior[/url] tiles and re-edited.

If you like this mod, it would make me very happy if you would endorse it. <3  Thank you!
